raw_input.ids: anonymous; producers store raw IDs unmapped
raw_input.preflight: the external seal receipt and the run seal verify before any image, semantic or GT read

track_a.name: gt_free_common_semantic_adapter
track_a.inputs: verified raw partition + image-only central plane + image-only record; no GT, no metric, no Track B output
track_a.firewall: ProducerAccessGuard over the cohort's source images only

track_b.name: raw_id_majority_vote_v1
track_b.unit: one sample (one 2-D slice) at a time
track_b.mapping_grid: native acquisition grid: raw map restored with the frozen nearest-exact label inverse (manifest spatial_transform.inverse_resize.mode_labels); GT is never resampled
track_b.rule: every raw ID is assigned, as a whole, to the class with the maximum count of valid GT pixels over all pixels of that raw ID

metrics.prediction_inverse: nearest_exact to native per manifest spatial transform (224 -> native for v12)
metrics.void_policy: VOID is never relabelled as BG; full-support foreground Dice/IoU treats VOID as no predicted named class and reports native-grid coverage separately
metrics.note: the reference evaluator contract file itself binds the DFC baseline and the 256 grid; it is reused by hash for its metric semantics and not modified
